question: How does a federal grant actually travel from Congress to a city, and what records prove each step?
answer: Congress sets the purpose and budget authority, OMB apportions it, HUD makes the prime awards (for FY2024 HOME: $23,907,179 to New York's Housing Trust Fund Corporation and $1,303,112.35 directly to the City of Syracuse), Treasury's Fiscal Service pays, and auditors test afterward. Of the 13 links in the route, 5 rest on a published award, outlay or audit record; 2 (the payments on to Home HeadQuarters) are still open, with no dated payment on the public record.

sections.title: The links, by how well they are proved
sections.sub: The whole route was checked through October 10, 2026; the rows carry no dates of their own.

items.title: 1. Congress
items.sub: Federal law · Sets public purpose and budget authority
kv: Authorizing statute and appropriation, not a grantee's bank receipt.
Can amend law and funding and conduct legislative oversight.
HOME law aims to expand affordable housing for low-income households; an appropriation gives spending authority for stated purposes and periods.

items.title: 2. OMB
items.sub: Federal budget control · Apportions available budget authority
kv: Apportionment and uniform assistance guidance, not a particular subaward.
Sets government-wide grant guidance; federal agencies implement program awards.
Controls the pace or purpose of agency obligations within enacted budget authority; it does not select the Syracuse HOME grantee.
United States > Executive Branch > Executive Office of the President > Office of Management & Budget

items.title: 3. HUD HOME
items.sub: Federal program · Designs HOME rules and makes the prime awards
kv: Program rule, award agreement, FAIN, obligation and federal draw records.
Sets award conditions and monitors each first legal recipient; the award rule requires named goals and terms.
Support affordable housing for low-income households through participating state and local jurisdictions.
United States > Executive Branch > Executive Departments > Dept of Housing & Urban Development

items.title: 4. Treasury Fiscal Service
items.sub: Federal payment service · Runs federal payment services; does not choose HOME projects
kv: Payment authorization, disbursement and federal account events where available; not the state or nonprofit's use of funds.
Payment controls are distinct from HUD program eligibility and HTFC or City monitoring.
Disburse approved federal payments through federal payment systems where the agency uses them.
United States > Executive Branch > Executive Departments > Dept of the Treasury > Bureau of the Fiscal Service

items.title: 5. New York HTFC
items.sub: State prime recipient · Holds the state HOME award and may pass funds on
kv: FY2024 HOME FAIN M24-SG360100; $23,907,179 reported obligation. State project agreements, IDIS draws and local account records are separate.
Selects, contracts with and monitors local subrecipients where it makes a subaward; the specific Champion payment remains unjoined.
Develop and preserve affordable housing across the state under the federal HOME purpose and New York's plan.

items.title: 6. City of Syracuse
items.sub: Direct local prime · Holds its own HOME award directly from HUD
kv: FY2024 HOME FAIN M24-MC360505; $1,303,112.35 reported obligation. Its FY2025 audit reports $511,147 of expenditures under this FAIN on a modified-accrual basis.
Must meet its own HUD terms and monitor any subrecipient. Its FY2025 HOME compliance opinion was qualified for rental-inspection controls; the finding is not about HHQ.
Use its housing plan to support housing production, repair, owner assistance and neighborhood stability within HOME rules.

items.title: 7. Home HeadQuarters
items.sub: Possible lower tier · Housing nonprofit; exact role depends on each agreement
kv: Its Form 990 reports organization-wide government grants and housing work, not a HOME project voucher or award-specific receipt.
Its board and grant staff report contract and voucher controls. For Champion, a signed subaward, payment and five completed homes remain unproved on the checked public record.
Its own mission says it improves housing and neighborhoods for underserved people in Syracuse and across Upstate New York.

items.title: 8. Auditors and oversight
items.sub: Independent check · Test selected accounts and requirements after the fact
kv: Single Audit, findings and management decisions; a finding is not by itself a final debt or collected recovery.
Federal agency and pass-through monitoring continue between audits and below the Single Audit threshold.
Assess financial statements or major-program compliance under bounded audit standards.
